_status: BLOCKED. Stryker 10 cannot run against this toolchain, so the numbers it reports are wrong, not merely low. Two separate problems: (1) Stryker's tsconfig preprocessor calls ts.parseConfigFileTextToJson, which TypeScript 7's compiler API no longer exposes, so a run crashes before it starts unless tsconfigFile points at a file that does not exist; (2) with that bypassed, mutants are not activated in the Vitest 5 worker, so almost everything is reported as surviving. Verified by hand: deleting the throw inside assertExact fails three tests locally, and Stryker reported that same mutant as survived. Until the runner supports TypeScript 7, use `npm run mutation` (scripts/mutation-smoke.mjs), which applies representative mutations one at a time and asserts the suite catches each. Re-check this file when @stryker-mutator/vitest-runner declares TypeScript 7 support.
